notes.subject: מרבדים
notes.rationale: Marbad 'coverlet' appears only here in the Tanakh; rendered fili-dilanw 'covering-things' to keep the physical picture.

notes.subject: shesh
notes.rationale: שש = fine white linen; kept as Hebrew term-marker because Bambara has no linen word and KJV's 'silk' is wrong.

notes.subject: argaman
notes.rationale: ארגמן purple dye/stuff kept transliterated like hesed-class terms; no Bambara dye vocabulary maps to it.

translation: Fili-dilanw, a ye ⟨ta⟩ a yɛrɛ ye; shesh ni argaman ye a funtuniya ye.
